title: COAL — Cloth Config adapter
description: Renders every COAL-using mod's settings screen in Cloth Config.
body:
Renders every [COAL](https://modrinth.com/mod/config-object-abstraction-lib)-using mod's settings screen
in [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config), plus JSON
persistence, load-time validation, and versioned migrations.

## For players

Install **all three** side-by-side in your `mods/` folder:

1. **[COAL](https://modrinth.com/mod/config-object-abstraction-lib)** — the abstraction layer that COAL-consuming mods depend on.
2. **coal-cloth-adapter** — this mod.
3. **[Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)** — the GUI library that actually renders the screens.

Any mod that consumes COAL will use Cloth Config for its settings screen once
these three are installed together.

### Cloth vs. YACL

Cloth Config's sub-category widget recurses cleanly, so this adapter
preserves deep-nested config trees end-to-end. YACL's equivalent flattens
after two levels. If your mods declare heavily-nested configs and you want
every level preserved in the GUI, pick this adapter.

### Don't install alongside `coal-yacl-adapter`

Only **one** COAL adapter should be installed at a time. If you'd rather use
YACL, install [`coal-yacl-adapter`](https://modrinth.com/mod/coal-yacl-adapter)
instead of this one.

## For mod authors

You don't compile against this mod. Depend on `coal-api` +
`coal-api-gui-<loader>` at compile time; your users install whichever adapter
they prefer at runtime. See the [docs](https://mc.oliveryasuna.com/coal/) for
the walkthrough.

## Feature coverage

Advertises `MIGRATION`, `VALIDATION`, and `GUI_DELEGATION`. Does not advertise
`SYNC`, `FILE_WATCH`, `JSON5`, or `CUSTOM_FORMATS` — see the module README on
GitHub for the full annotation-to-widget mapping and known limitations.
